string.name: text
string.value: The Dark Lord suspected that the Seal Stone was stolen by the Master of Disguise, a member of the Black Wings.

string.name: text
string.value: But none of the Job Instructors understood why the Black Wings would want a Seal Stone. They needed more information.

string.name: text
string.value: They sent you to Ereve to gather intel from the Cygnus Knights and to Edelstein, to speak to the Resistance.

string.name: text
string.value: Both Neinheart, the cold-hearted tactician of the knights, and Claudine, a leader of the notoriously close-lipped Resistance, provided you with all the knowledge they could.

string.name: text
string.value: Slowly, you pieced together that the Black Wings wanted to cause strife within the Explorer ranks. But why?
